items.title: Burke Stevenson Interview, 1959-06-12
items.q: And we had Edgar on drum, George Lewis on clarinet, Billy on piano, myself on trumpet.

ctx.x: Oh, is that where the chicken place is now?
That's right. That's right. That's right. And we had Edgar on drum, George Lewis on clarinet, Billy on piano, myself on trumpet. Is that Edgar Mosley?
